Breakfast at the hotel. The included group sightseeing tour of Santiago is led by an English-speaking guide.

Explore Santiago on a group sightseeing tour with an English-speaking guide. The tour begins downtown at the square by La Moneda Palace, a designated historic monument. Built in 1799 in the final years of Spanish rule, the palace was designed in the traditional neoclassical style to house the Royal Mint. The Chilean government took over the building in the mid-19th century, and La Moneda has been the seat of government ever since. Next, visit the Plaza de Armas, Santiago’s main square and the place where the city began. The square is home to the former Governors’ Palace, Santiago City Hall, the Central Post Office, the Royal Audiencia building and the Metropolitan Cathedral. Then head up Santa Lucía Hill for panoramic views across the city. The tour continues through the modern districts of Vitacura, Las Condes and Providencia, then follows the Mapocho River and takes in the architecture along Santiago’s main avenues.
For an additional charge, you can visit wineries in the Maipo Valley for a tasting. The price is $230 per person, with a minimum of two participants.
